summary: API v2 lets a job template have many credentials (multicloud); filter credentials with ?credential_type__namespace=aws, and v2 credential kinds map Machine to SSH, Vault, Network, SCM, Cloud, Insights and Galaxy.
questions: How do I filter credentials by type in the API?
What changed with credentials between api/v1 and api/v2?
Can a job template have multiple credentials in API v2?
